title: Title & Registration Services Buyer Reimbursement Limits and Claim Periods
content:
Under Title & Registration Services, the amounts Kestrel reimburses to a buyer, the period for submitting an expired-temp-tag citation and the payment period are fixed per service type as follows.

| Service type | State late-registration penalty reimbursed | Expired-temp-tag citation cap (USD) | Citation claim period (calendar days after the citation date) | VIN inspection and emissions test fee cap (USD) | Reimbursement paid within (business days after approval) | Maximum reimbursement entries per order (all reasons) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Title-Only Service | No | 0.00 | 60 | 0.00 | 10 | 3 |
| Kestrel In-State Plate Transfer | Yes | 150.00 | 60 | 0.00 | 10 | 3 |
| Kestrel In-State New Registration | Yes | 150.00 | 60 | 0.00 | 10 | 3 |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration | Yes | 150.00 | 60 | 0.00 | 10 | 3 |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection | Yes | 200.00 | 60 | 40.00 | 10 | 3 |
| Kestrel Specialty Plate Registration | Yes | 150.00 | 60 | 0.00 | 10 | 3 |

## Terms of the schedule

1. A cap is the most that is reimbursed for that cost on the order; a cap of 0.00 means nothing is reimbursed for that cost under that service type.
2. The late-registration penalty column states only whether the service type reimburses late penalties at all. Kestrel Title-Only Service does not; the other five service types do.
3. The maximum of 3 reimbursement entries is counted per order across all reasons together.

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical inputs)

- A Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection buyer submits a VIN inspection and emissions receipt of 55.00: the cap for that service type is 40.00, so no more than 40.00 is reimbursed. The same receipt under Kestrel Out-of-State Registration has a cap of 0.00.
- A citation dated 2 August reaches the 60-day claim period's last day on 1 October.
